\int 2 \cdot 5^{x^{2} + 2} x\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

$$

$$

$$
\int 5^{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\frac{5^{u}}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}+C.
$$

$$
